title: spec: ExecutionContext carries each granted permission set as (package, name) beside permissions (ADR-0150, prerequisite of #31698)
body:
epic:#31527#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmP7o3uDTti21wLTfPf

Filing gate: ④ coordination node. A missing child of the epic #31527 (ADR-0150) that #31698's step 0 found (seat 3, claim amendment 6747867088; readings in `/mnt/project-files/server-seat3/31698-step0.md`). ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: inherited from #31527 (p1). The permission-set backstop cannot be narrowed (#31698) while the authorization pipeline carries a permission set as a bare name. `ExecutionContext.permissions` is `z.array(z.string())` (spec `kernel/execution-context.zod.ts`), so every evaluator that turns it back into a set body resolves the bare name again. With two holders it would take the first (red line 1) or drop a lawful grant.
Reader: the `domain:spec` seat.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `ExecutionContext permissions package`. #31669 (P) carried namespaces on MCP and address shapes, not the execution context. Nothing else is on point.
class: c · type: Feature
Part of #31527. Blocks: the server half filed beside this card.

## 维护者速读

执行上下文里的权限集现在只有名字。要加一个可选的兄弟字段，同时带上包和名字，让授权下游能精确拿到“哪个包的哪个权限集”。纯新增，旧字段不动。

## What to build

- In `ExecutionContext`, add an **optional, additive** sibling of `permissions` that carries each granted permission set as `(packageId | null, name)`. `null` means the environment's own set or the platform's. The field name and shape are the spec seat's call (new public names are the seat's call).
- `permissions: string[]` stays exactly as it is, as the display and compatibility field, with the same order and contents. No consumer is broken.
- **Changeset:** a minor addition, with `Metadata-protocol: none`. It is not a metadata shape. `Clause-②: no`.
- Hand the derived name to the server half in the card's landing record.

## Red lines (the epic seat reviews the PR against them, ruling 6723571682)

1. Never loosens: additive only, and no reader moves in this card.
2. Never guesses: the field is filled only from a resolved `(package, name)`. A name the rule refuses never appears in it.
3. Independently releasable: with the field absent, every consumer behaves exactly as today.
